concepts.definition: Periodic communications distributed within an organization to share updates, news, or announcements.
Formal statements or notifications intended to inform members of an organization about specific events or updates.
Summarized collections of recent updates or changes within an organization, typically shared in a concise format.
Concise documents or summaries prepared for executives, focusing on key information and decisions.
Documents or materials created for internal communication purposes within an organization.
